name: ragbase-shield
description: Local pseudonymisation for client files. The model reads dossier documents masked (PERSONNE_A, SOCIETE_B, IBAN_1) through a local MCP server; the table of codes and real names stays on your computer.

interface.shortDescription: Work on client files with codes for detected names
interface.longDescription: RAGbase Shield pseudonymises client data on your computer before the model sees it. Register a dossier folder with Shield Desk, then ask for work on DOSSIER_n: the model reads masked documents through the Shield tools and saves the final draft with shield_save_draft. The real names are restored locally, in the 'Shield - sorties' folder of the dossier. No telemetry, no network calls. Pseudonymisation (reversible), not anonymisation.
defaultPrompt: Read the documents of DOSSIER_1 and draft a summary, then save it with shield_save_draft.
